verdict.rationale: Bun documents multiple bulk-operation primitives for a package manager: `--filter` to target/install subsets of workspaces (bun-docs-9, bun-docs-21, bun-docs-32, bun-docs-51), `bun update` to bump every dependency at once (bun-docs-42) with `--interactive` for selective bulk choice (bun-docs-43), `bun audit` to fix all vulnerable packages in one pass (bun-docs-7), `bun dedupe`/`bun prune` operating across the whole dependency tree (bun-docs-44, bun-docs-45), and catalogs to apply one version across many workspace packages (bun-docs-11, bun-docs-22). These are genuine bulk/automation-depth capabilities for a package manager. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that these bulk operations behave reliably at scale (one community comment flags uncertainty about per-package script bulk actions in monorepos, bun-comm-10) and no evidence of scriptable/API-level bulk automation beyond CLI flags.
